title: Body of POST /api/v1/diagram: the only way to change a diagram
description: Same envelope as write-request.json, on its own route and store: diagram writes go to <data>/diagrams.ndjson plus media blobs, never to events.ndjson, so a rollback to a board without diagrams still replays its journal and starts (the mailbox and delivery precedent). The envelope is validated first, then `data` against diagram/<op>.json (the part after 'diagram.'). Identity comes from the credential, never from the body; rev 2 (M5): an owner-role actor must be an owner UI credential (owner proxy login, a device token, or a ui token), else 403 owner_ui_only, checked before data is read. origin is never used for identity. Roles, revision rule and pinned rule come from each op file's x-roles, x-revision, x-pinned, as OP_RULES does for journal ops. request_id: a retry with the same id and body returns the original result; the same id with another body is 409 request_id_reused. The prefix 'diagram-' is reserved for the board's own pointer writes on POST /api/v1/write (400 reserved_request_id there).

target_id.description: The task whose diagram this is. Must be a task on the board (404 task_not_found) inside the token's scope (403 out_of_scope).

expected_revision.description: The diagram rev the client read. Required when the op says x-revision=required; a stale value is 409 revision_conflict {current_revision}.

origin.description: Declared relay origin, unverified metadata (e.g. zumi-pack-diagram).
